close_reason: Added a # Security docstring section to SetError::with_description that mirrors the JmapBackend::Error contract: credential / blob / PII MUST NOT appear in the description. Also notes that SetError paths are MORE leak-prone than serverFail because adversarial /set inputs can probe descriptions reliably. Points callers at server_fail_from_backend (introduced in bd:JMAP-wlip.2) for wrapping downstream errors safely. Pure doc change; rustdoc with -D warnings is clean.
title: SetError::with_description has no security warning despite being a wire-bound, client-visible leak path parallel to JmapBackend::Error::Display
